_comment: Recorded shapes of the two 2026-08-06 runs the watchdog exists to tell apart, trimmed to the
fields check() actually reads. Kept as a file so check.test.js needs no GH_TOKEN and no
network: the old test hit the live API, so it could not run in CI, and it would rot silently
once those runs age out of Actions retention.
31119619358 - GitHub never allocated a runner. The alarm job was cancelled with ZERO steps,
so nothing notified and the phone stayed silent. This is the run the watchdog exists for.
31122686346 - the run itself was cancelled, but the alarm job SUCCEEDED because report had
already sent `done` for 16 finished rows. Paging here is the false alarm this replaces.
